# Andrea Saravia Sauter — SARAUTER

> Marketing strategist for complex products · AI visibility (SEO, AEO, GEO). She turns complex technology into a clear commercial message and makes sure it shows up where buyers now search: on Google and in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini. 20+ years across Latin America and Europe. Based in Madrid, Spain.

Andrea Saravia Sauter is a marketing strategist specializing in complex products: technology, software, infrastructure and AI that buyers don't understand at first glance. She works on message and positioning, go-to-market, international events and visibility in search and AI engines (SEO, AEO and GEO). She was Marketing Director at Ufinet for eight years (2014–2022), building the marketing department from scratch and the brand across 17 countries, backed by a written reference from Ufinet's CEO. Ufinet hired her again in December 2025 as a brand marketing consultant. She has also led marketing projects for Gold Data and Todofibraoptica. Her core experience is in telecom and digital infrastructure, and she applies the same method to any complex product. She holds a Master in Digital Marketing (ESIC Business & Marketing School, Madrid) and Anthropic certifications in Claude, Claude Code, AI Fluency, Agent Skills, Subagents and Claude Cowork, and has designed and built her own AI marketing tools.
